description: This file is a shell script that provides functions and logic for handling firmware images and upgrades for various router hardware platforms, including firmware identification, validation, and upgrade procedures.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs as a hex string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs as a little-endian number.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines whether the device uses serial or NAND flash based on /proc/mtd.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image filename based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and board ID by examining magic bytes in the firmware image.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image matches the device, including format and board ID.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main entry point for validating the firmware image, with device-specific exceptions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles upgrading NAND devices with TRX firmware images, extracting partitions, and flashing.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Handles NAND upgrade using Seama seal files, extracting UBI images, and flashing.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts firmware partitions from a SafeLoader image for upgrade.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedures based on the firmware format and type.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that calls specific upgrade functions based on the device.
